connector.name: Engram by tomcat65
connector.registryDescription: Coordination bus + shared truth for AI agent fleets - self-hosted MCP server + stdio bridge.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package engram-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the tomcat65 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: API_KEY
env.description: Shared API key authenticating the bridge to your self-hosted Engram server (generate with: npx -y @tomcat65/engram-mcp init)
